Інформація щодо розклад руху міського електричного та автомобільного транспорту у місті Сміла. Coverage: Смілянська міська рада. The publisher named on the listing is Смілянська міська рада. Its keywords include громадський транспорт. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2024-02-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
